Body lengths and alphabet are not provider-stated, except that Docker's Hub API spec (createOrgAccessTokenResponse.token) shows an example OAT with a 27-character alphanumeric body, on example strength only. The 27-character dckr_pat_ body, the 32-character dckr_oat_ width and the [A-Za-z0-9_-] alphabet remain tool-corroborated [Legacy contract 'docker-token' is shared by 2 families; this statement is not specific to one of them.]
